_comment: The LF-tag ontology. In a deployment this lives in the governance account
and is read with lakeformation.list_lf_tags(); here it is a file. Either
way it is governance-owned: the executor holds no opinion about what
'sensitivity: high' permits, and cannot resolve a value nobody defined.
Adding a value is a governance pull request, not a pipeline change.
This file mirrors the Terraform in fabric-mesh-on-aws § 3 and is not an
independent definition. It must not drift: a key the executor accepts but
Terraform never created cannot be applied to LakeFormation at all, so the
run passes policy.resolve() and then fails at the AWS API.
